source.attribution: Facsimile by Laetitia Gallet; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 65120

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 65120; AKU grapheme F0590 (AKU GR 246). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: F40 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 172bis, 173bis, 577. Source publication of this facsimile: Tallet 2017. Occurrence: find place Wadi el-Jarf; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 8 x 8.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 4. Dynastie, Cheops, Regierungsjahr 26 – Altes Reich, 4. Dynastie, Cheops, Regierungsjahr 27". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Laetitia Gallet. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
